# NEW 2026-11-17 theme-rework UI-2: found all themes at once, opening choice, move a theme's administrative seat.
# Generated by gen_theme_setup.py; edit the generator and regenerate instead of editing by hand.

# Any scope. Founds a military theme at scope:oe_theme_seat (a historical region centre).
# Same steps as the region branch of oe_create_theme (generic_actions/oe_byz_empire_theme_org.txt), without its cost;
# keep the two in step when either changes.
oe_theme_found_at_seat = {
    scope:oe_theme_seat = {
        create_building_country_in_location = {
            religion = religion:orthodox
            culture = culture:oe_roman_noble_culture
            subject_type = subject_type:oe_empire_theme
            overlord = c:BYZ
            reforms = { oe_byz_theme_system_subject }
            hidden_effect = {
                change_government_type = government_type:monarchy
                change_heir_selection = heir_selection:oe_rome_province_elect
            }
            save_scope_as = target_building_country
        }
        construct_building = {
            building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_system_noble
            owner = scope:target_building_country
            cost_multiplier = 0
            cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
        }
    }
    scope:target_building_country = {
        if = { limit = { exists = ruler } ruler = { add_trait = trait:oe_character_war_score_trait_VI } }
    }
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
        add_country_to_international_organization = scope:target_building_country
        international_organization_add_special_status = {
            type = special_status:oe_pillars_theme
            country = scope:target_building_country
        }
    }
    # Historical name from the seat (gen_theme_names.py).
    scope:oe_theme_seat = { save_scope_as = oe_theme_name_seat }
    scope:target_building_country = { oe_theme_apply_name = yes }
    scope:target_building_country = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_region_id value = scope:oe_theme_seat.var:oe_theme_region }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_theme_seat = { has_variable = oe_theme_region_tier } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_theme_distance value = scope:oe_theme_seat.var:oe_theme_region_tier }
        }
    }
    c:BYZ = {
        every_owned_location = {
            limit = { var:oe_theme_region ?= scope:oe_theme_seat.var:oe_theme_region }
            construct_building = {
                building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_system
                owner = scope:target_building_country
                cost_multiplier = 0
                cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
            }
        }
    }
    # The new country's capital link resolves to a location scope during this effect; use the seat itself.
    scope:oe_theme_seat = {
        while = {
            count = 3
            create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = oe_byz_theme_subject_soldier_I owner = scope:target_building_country }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { is_coastal = yes }
            while = {
                count = 6
                create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = n_cog owner = scope:target_building_country }
            }
        }
    }
    scope:target_building_country = {
        set_gold = 300
        add_manpower = 3
        # Author decision 2026-11-17: no food-access relation on founding.
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Founds a theme in every region whose centre is creatable now.
# $cost$ = Authority per theme (0 at the opening choice); stops when Authority runs out.
# Counts what it founded in var:oe_theme_found_all_count (set to 0 by the caller).
oe_theme_found_all = {
    every_owned_location = {
        limit = { oe_theme_region_center_creatable = yes }
        if = {
            limit = {
                oe_theme_region_center_creatable = yes
                international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { var:oe_pillars_authority >= $cost$ }
            }
            save_scope_as = oe_theme_seat
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -$cost$ } }
            oe_theme_found_at_seat = yes
            c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_theme_found_all_count add = 1 } }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. Moves the administrative seat of scope:oe_ms_theme to scope:oe_ms_new (old one saved as scope:oe_ms_old).
# The new seat building is built first, the capital moved, and only then the old seat building removed.
oe_theme_move_seat = {
    if = {
        limit = { scope:oe_ms_theme = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_naval } }
        scope:oe_ms_new = { construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_naval_seat owner = scope:oe_ms_theme cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" } }
        scope:oe_ms_theme = { set_capital = scope:oe_ms_new }
        scope:oe_ms_old = { if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:oe_byz_theme_naval_seat } destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:oe_byz_theme_naval_seat|scope:oe_ms_theme)" } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { scope:oe_ms_theme = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_administrative } }
        scope:oe_ms_new = { construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_administrative_seat owner = scope:oe_ms_theme cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" } }
        scope:oe_ms_theme = { set_capital = scope:oe_ms_new }
        scope:oe_ms_old = { if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:oe_byz_theme_administrative_seat } destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:oe_byz_theme_administrative_seat|scope:oe_ms_theme)" } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { scope:oe_ms_theme = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_frontier } }
        scope:oe_ms_new = { construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_frontier_seat owner = scope:oe_ms_theme cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" } }
        scope:oe_ms_theme = { set_capital = scope:oe_ms_new }
        scope:oe_ms_old = { if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:oe_byz_theme_frontier_seat } destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:oe_byz_theme_frontier_seat|scope:oe_ms_theme)" } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { scope:oe_ms_theme = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_italian } }
        scope:oe_ms_new = { construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_italian_seat owner = scope:oe_ms_theme cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" } }
        scope:oe_ms_theme = { set_capital = scope:oe_ms_new }
        scope:oe_ms_old = { if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:oe_byz_theme_italian_seat } destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:oe_byz_theme_italian_seat|scope:oe_ms_theme)" } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { scope:oe_ms_theme = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_latin } }
        scope:oe_ms_new = { construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_latin_seat owner = scope:oe_ms_theme cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" } }
        scope:oe_ms_theme = { set_capital = scope:oe_ms_new }
        scope:oe_ms_old = { if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:oe_byz_theme_latin_seat } destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:oe_byz_theme_latin_seat|scope:oe_ms_theme)" } }
    }
    else = {
        scope:oe_ms_new = { construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_system_noble owner = scope:oe_ms_theme cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" } }
        scope:oe_ms_theme = { set_capital = scope:oe_ms_new }
        scope:oe_ms_old = { if = { limit = { has_building = building_type:oe_byz_theme_system_noble } destroy_building_forcefully = "building(building_type:oe_byz_theme_system_noble|scope:oe_ms_theme)" } }
    }
    scope:oe_ms_theme = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_seat_moved_cd years = 10 }
        set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty
    }
}
